dict.string: Vornyx Notch asks Music and Spotify what is playing, and sends play, pause and skip when you use the notch's controls.
Vornyx Notch shows your next events on the dashboard. They are read on this Mac and never leave it.
Vornyx Notch shows your next events on the dashboard. They are read on this Mac and never leave it.
Vornyx Notch shows a live mirror inside the notch when you open it. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Vornyx Notch shows your reminders beside your events on the dashboard.
Vornyx Notch shows your reminders beside your events on the dashboard.
Vornyx Notch reads the levels of the audio playing so the bars in the notch move with it. No audio is recorded, and nothing on screen is captured.
Vornyx Notch reads the battery levels of your connected AirPods to show them in the notch.
Vornyx Notch finds devices running LocalSend on your network, so you can send files to them from the notch and receive files from them.
Vornyx Notch uses your location to show the local forecast on the dashboard. You can name a place in Settings instead.
